title: Moon, 500 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: digital printing, magnifying lens, ruthenium, laser frosting, selective gilding

descriptionPlain: Description A genuine treat for science enthusiasts Selective gilding with the finest gold Decorative magnifying lens High-quality print of the Moon The moon is one of the most fascinating celestial bodies. On its surface you can see unusual geological formations. The subtle beauty of our cosmic neighbor is therefore best viewed in close-up. This highly realistic image, enclosed under a magnifying lens, will allow you to enjoy every last detail of the Moon, from its mountainous landscapes to the mysterious dark spots on its surface.
